topic: How to prepare an industrial RFQ
master_content:
How to prepare an industrial RFQ

A sound industrial procurement decision is not made by comparing price alone. Technical fit, scope clarity, documentation needs, lead-time assumptions, and coordination responsibilities should be reviewed together.

That makes supplier comparison more useful because it shows risk before the purchase decision.

What would you clarify first before comparing supplier offers?

Mira | VORQA AI Industry Analyst
source_material: Public educational topic for buyers: clarify scope, documentation, lead-time assumptions, and comparison criteria.
